notes: The only atom allowed raw <input>, <select>, <textarea> elements. Label, description, and error render through Text atom. Native HTML controls for AT/AAC compatibility. Card-select renders choices as pictogram cards with hidden native inputs for low-cognitive-level scenarios. Assistive render applied via [data-render='assistive'] zone (assistive-gate.css), not a separate template. WCAG 2.2 AA audit: formfield-wcag-audit-2026-05-14.md.

identity._description: Technical identifiers — form submission and ARIA wiring.

id.description: Element ID. Kebab-case, leading letter (WCAG 4.1.1). Generates aria-describedby IDs (-error, -desc, -suggestion, -label).

type.description: Input type. 'card-select' renders options as tappable pictogram/text cards (low-cognitive-level alternative to radio/checkbox).

content._description: User-visible text. The 'what is being asked' surface — free strings authored per instance (WCAG 2.4.6).

label._note: REQUIRED. Must visually describe the field's purpose (WCAG 2.4.6). Accessible name must match visible text (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name).

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown inside the field when empty.
placeholder._note: NOT a label (WCAG 3.3.2). Disappears on input. Use label + description for instructions; placeholder is a hint only.

description.description: Helper text shown below the label.
description._note: Linked via aria-describedby. Use for input hints or format examples (WCAG 3.3.2).

error.description: Error message shown when validation fails.
error._note: Announced via role='alert' + aria-live='assertive' + aria-atomic='true' (WCAG 3.3.1, 4.1.3). Linked via aria-describedby + aria-invalid='true'.

suggestion._note: WCAG 3.3.3 — provide a suggestion when error is something the user can fix (e.g. 'Did you mean .com?').

state._description: Current values. Server-rendered initial state; consumer JS controls updates.

value.description: Current value. For checkbox/radio/toggle use 'checked' instead.

checked._note: Toggle (type='toggle') has aria-checked synced via JS on change events.

radioValue.description: Submission value for radio inputs (separate from group 'value' for selection comparison).

behaviour._description: Input constraints and HTML form attributes. Restricts what the user can enter — WCAG 1.3.5 + 3.3.x.

disabled.description: Disabled state. Use sparingly — disabled controls don't receive focus and aren't announced as 'disabled' consistently across AT.

rows._note: Minimum 2 — single-row textareas should be type='text' instead (WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow).

minLength._note: WCAG 3.3.1 — communicate constraints via description prop too.

maxLength._note: WCAG 3.3.1 — communicate constraints via description prop too.

pattern._note: WCAG 3.3.1 — pair with description prop to explain the format requirement in plain language. Pattern alone is not user-friendly.

inputMode._note: Smart default per type: email→email, tel→tel, number→decimal, search→search, url→url, password→text. Override only if needed.

autocomplete.description: Browser autofill purpose token (WCAG 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose).
autocomplete._note: Smart default per type: email→email, tel→tel, password→current-password, search/text/textarea/url→no default (author declares). 54 official HTML5 tokens. Browser autofill helps users with cognitive disabilities.

spellcheck._note: Smart default per type: textarea/text/search→true, password/email/tel/url→false. Set explicitly only to override.

options.description: Options for select or card-select. See SelectOption shape in _selectOptionShape.

maxSelections.description: Card-select: max number of selections. 1 = single-select (radio behaviour). >1 = multi-select (checkbox behaviour).

a11y._description: Explicit accessibility flags. Most a11y wiring is automatic via aria-* attrs.

hideLabel.description: Visually hide label (keeps it in DOM via sr-only).
hideLabel._note: Use sparingly. Visible labels preferred for cognitive accessibility (WCAG 3.3.2). Label MUST still match accessible name when visually hidden (WCAG 2.5.3).

visual._description: How the field looks. No content here — visual variants only.

cardColumns.description: Card-select: grid columns in full render. Assistive renders force 1 column regardless.

colour._description: FormField consumes the global .color--{name} mixin via FormField.astro emitting `color--{name}` on the wrapper. Internal --_field-brand/-dark/-light read --_color/--_tier-emphasis/--_tier-tint set by the mixin. rainbowColor wins over brandColor when both are set. brandColor='neutral' additionally triggers a muted-surface treatment (see CSS).

brandColor.description: Brand colour family. 'text' = body text scale, always readable, theme-stable. 'neutral' picks up an extra muted-surface treatment.

rainbowColor.description: Rainbow colour family. Overrides brandColor when set.

colorTier._note: Tier values: tint=faintest, mid=softer, base=full saturation, emphasis=loudest. Implicit baseline is 'base'. Omit to use.

_selectOptionShape._description: Shape of each entry in options[] when type='select' or 'card-select'. Per-option media slot composes Image OR Icon atom (constrained subset of their props).

simple.description: Simplified label for low-cognitive-level rendering. Falls back to 'label' when absent.

description.description: Helper text below the option label (card-select only).

display.description: Check indicator style override (card-select only). Default: matches input type.

aacPhrase.description: AAC keyword/phrase for build-time pictogram resolution.
aacPhrase._note: FORWARD-DECLARED — resolver wiring is deferred. Currently has NO runtime effect; only opt.media renders. When the AAC pipeline is wired, this will resolve via loadAllAltText() + resolveAACWord at build time → render as <Image> (or fall back to label text). Card-select only. If 'media' is also set, 'media' wins.

media._description: Per-option visual — Image or Icon atom (constrained subset of props). Card-select only. Wins over aacPhrase if both set.

src.description: Image URL or imported asset path.

alt._note: WCAG 1.1.1. Use '' ONLY when semanticRole='decorative' (the card label provides the accessible name). For semanticRole='content-symbol' the alt must describe the symbol's meaning (e.g. 'happy face' not 'icon').
